trees.name: Bladecraft
trees.subtitle: Mastery of Steel
trees.description: The ancient discipline of swordsmanship. Master devastating strikes, precise attacks, and techniques capable of overwhelming even the strongest enemies.

skills.name: Power Strike
skills.description: Channel your strength into a devastating melee attack that deals increased damage to a single enemy.
skills.effect: Increases melee attack damage by 8% per rank.

skills.name: Keen Edge
skills.description: Through relentless training, your weapon strikes become more precise, exposing weaknesses in enemy defenses.
skills.effect: Increases critical hit chance by 2% per rank.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.description: Spin your weapon in a deadly arc, striking nearby enemies with a powerful sweeping attack.
skills.effect: Deals 110% weapon damage to nearby enemies, increasing by 20% per rank.

skills.name: Executioner
skills.description: Learn to recognize the final moments of a weakened enemy and deliver a decisive finishing blow.
skills.effect: Deals 12% additional damage per rank to enemies below 30% health.

skills.name: Blade Storm
skills.description: Unleash a relentless storm of steel, striking multiple times with extraordinary speed and precision.
skills.effect: Performs 4 rapid strikes. Each rank increases total damage by 25%.

skills.name: Kingslayer
skills.description: The legendary technique of ancient swordmasters, capable of bringing even mighty kings to their knees.
skills.effect: Unleashes a devastating attack dealing 350% weapon damage and ignoring 20% enemy defense.

trees.name: Guardian
trees.subtitle: The Unbroken Shield
trees.description: A discipline devoted to endurance, defense, and unwavering courage. Become an unstoppable protector capable of surviving the deadliest battles.

skills.name: Iron Skin
skills.description: Harden your body and armor through rigorous training, reducing damage from enemy attacks.
skills.effect: Increases total defense by 5% per rank.

skills.name: Vitality
skills.description: Strengthen your physical endurance and increase your ability to withstand prolonged combat.
skills.effect: Increases maximum health by 7% per rank.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description: Strike an enemy with overwhelming defensive force, interrupting their attack and briefly stunning them.
skills.effect: Deals 80% defense-based damage and stuns the target for 1 second, increasing by 0.5 seconds per rank.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.description: Draw upon your last reserves of strength when close to defeat, recovering your fighting spirit.
skills.effect: Restores 10% maximum health per rank when health falls below 25%. Activates once per battle.

skills.name: Living Fortress
skills.description: Become an immovable fortress, reducing incoming damage while standing your ground against overwhelming enemies.
skills.effect: Reduces incoming damage by 10% per rank for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Last Stand
skills.description: Refuse to fall when others would perish. Through sheer determination, withstand a fatal blow and continue fighting.
skills.effect: Survive one fatal attack with 20% maximum health remaining. Activates once per battle.

trees.name: Ember Arts
trees.subtitle: Flames of the Ancients
trees.description: Wield the forgotten power of primordial flame. Infuse weapons with fire, unleash devastating magic, and command the destructive force of the ancient embers.

skills.name: Ember Touch
skills.description: Infuse your weapon with magical embers, allowing each strike to carry additional fire damage.
skills.effect: Adds 6% fire damage to weapon attacks per rank.

skills.name: Arcane Focus
skills.description: Improve your control over ancient magical energies, strengthening elemental attacks and abilities.
skills.effect: Increases elemental ability damage by 5% per rank.

skills.name: Flame Wave
skills.description: Release a blazing wave of fire that burns enemies standing in front of you.
skills.effect: Deals 100% fire damage in a frontal cone, increasing by 25% per rank.

skills.name: Lightning Brand
skills.description: Charge your weapon with volatile arcane electricity, causing attacks to release bursts of lightning.
skills.effect: Grants a 10% chance per rank to deal bonus lightning damage.

skills.name: Inferno
skills.description: Summon an expanding inferno that engulfs surrounding enemies in searing magical flames.
skills.effect: Deals 150% fire damage over 5 seconds, increasing by 30% per rank.

skills.name: Phoenix Soul
skills.description: Awaken the mythical essence of the phoenix, surrounding yourself with sacred flames that restore life and burn nearby enemies.
skills.effect: Restores 40% maximum health and unleashes a fiery explosion dealing 250% elemental damage.
